blogs.title: Beyond the Horizon: How We Killed the 128k Limit
blogs.description: Explore the 'Holy Grail' of LLMs: context windows exceeding 1 million tokens. This post breaks down how LongRoPE overcomes the three massive hurdles—catastrophic values, scarcity of long training texts, and attention dispersion—to redefine what's possible for AI agents and document analysis.

blogs.title: The Evolutionary Search for Perfect Positioning
blogs.description: Why can't we just stretch the clock forward? Dive into the core innovation of LongRoPE: using an evolutionary algorithm to perform a multi-dimensional search. Learn how the model discovers unique 'rescale factors' for every RoPE dimension and token position to preserve information entropy, achieving an 8x extension without any extra training.

blogs.title: Scale Smart, Not Hard: The Progressive Strategy to 2M Tokens
blogs.description: Training on 2-million-token documents is prohibitively expensive. Discover LongRoPE's elegant 'step-by-step' approach. We'll explain how we first extend to 256k with lightweight fine-tuning, then use a second interpolation step to leapfrog to 2048k, all while keeping hardware costs manageable.

blogs.title: Don't Lose Your Way: Recovering Short-Context Performance
blogs.description: Often, boosting long-context capabilities ruins the model's ability to handle standard tasks. See how LongRoPE solves this paradox. By dynamically readingjusting RoPE factors specifically for shorter sequences (4k-8k), we prove you can have a marathon runner that still sprints effectively on a track.
